receipts.detail: memo decrypted locally from the tx mined at 4582095, outputs in Ironwood, after 3 sync(s)
receipts.leaks: The light-wallet server sees the runner's IP and when it syncs. It serves the same compact blocks to everyone, so it does not learn which transactions are ours. The memo never leaves the machine.

The light-wallet server learns your IP address and exactly which transaction you care about. That is a real disclosure, and it is why this goes to a light-wallet server over TLS instead of to a third-party explorer: one party instead of two. Routing it through Nym would remove the IP, and has not been done yet.

receipts.detail: No sealed txid yet. Set ZCASH_NOW_SEALED_TXID to the txid of a shielded payment approved in a wallet. This recipe is human-gated: Noir Wallet requires approval, so it cannot run on a schedule.
receipts.leaks: On chain: nothing about amount, sender or receiver, which is the point of a shielded payment. Off chain: the wallet's own light-wallet server sees your IP and the moment you broadcast, which is a timing signal. The memo is readable by every holder of the viewing key. And once the txid is published as a receipt here, this particular payment is publicly linked to this project, which is a disclosure we chose to make and would not make with a real user's payment.
